tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), positive nitrites, leukocyte esterase, and hematuria. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No casts were seen, which argues against upper tract involvement. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
